free_tier.stated: Free, no card needed: a 10-minute free trial on a random <name>.tunn.dev subdomain with HTTPS and WebSockets; Pro/Teams USD 4 per user per month: no time limit, up to 20 custom subdomains, up to 5 active tunnels per user

retention.stated: the generated subdomain is per session

egress.terms: no byte cap or transfer allowance is stated for any plan; the pricing section says: Higher volume? Contact us

record.chaining: composes with an origin and no domain, and with nothing that needs a published quota.

limits.value: no byte cap or transfer allowance is published for any plan; the pricing section lists time (10-minute free trial) and tunnel count (up to 5 active tunnels per user on Pro/Teams) and refers higher volume to the vendor

identity_cost.detail: an account for reserved subdomains; generated names need none

record.reliability_note: no byte cap is published and limits are set per plan on the pricing section; the terms reserve the right to bill overages, cancel a plan or revoke access when plan limits are not maintained

evidence.proved: the free install line and the USD 4/month pricing block

record.notes: Open-source reverse tunnel tool written in Rust. Free service provides random public subdomains without published bandwidth caps.

extras.transit_note: the tunnel relays the origin's bytes

record.binding_note: No byte cap is published, so no byte volume binds. What ends a free tunnel is the 10-minute trial window, a time limit that the limits vocabulary has no kind for.
